dates.title: Tulane Admission — Important Dates, Deadlines & Forms

test_policy.notes: The application checklist lists "SAT or ACT Scores" as optional. The 2025-2026 Common Data Set (Fall 2027) also marks SAT/ACT as "not required for admission, but considered if submitted". The admissions pages do not state the policy in a single sentence.

requirements.notes: Checklist: application (activities list and personal statement), high school transcript, and the Secondary School Report / school counselor recommendation. "We do not require teacher recommendations (only a counselor recommendation)." SAT/ACT scores and portfolio or audition materials are optional. The pages reviewed do not state the application fee, a writing supplement, or an interview policy, so those are not shown. ED and ED II applicants must submit a CSS Profile.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Binding. Decisions "by December 15"; enrollment deposit due January 15. Need-based aid applications (CSS Profile) due November 15.

deadlines.label: Early Action
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. Decisions "by January 10"; enrollment deposit due May 1. Need-based aid applications due December 15.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Binding. Decisions "by February 15"; enrollment deposit due March 1. Need-based aid applications due January 15.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decisions "by April 1" (includes deferred Early Action applicants); enrollment deposit due May 1. Need-based aid applications due February 15. The pages state no entry year, so the 2026-27 cycle (Fall 2027 entry) is assumed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for non-native English speakers (TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo English Test or Cambridge C1/C2). Waived with SAT reading/writing 600+ or ACT English 27+, or if the student has studied in a country where English is an official language (contact an admission counselor if the portal does not apply the waiver). The page is undated and does not mention the new 1-6 TOEFL scale.

english.notes: Page lists "TOEFL iBT minimum score: 95" and says successful applicants typically score 95+.
"Successful applicants typically score" 6.5+; no hard minimum stated.
"Successful applicants typically score" 130+; no hard minimum stated.
Cambridge C1/C2 scores accepted; no minimum stated.

aid.notes: "Tulane University offers limited need-based financial assistance to international students"; submit the CSS Profile by 15 February. International students must also complete the Certification of Finances form in the Green Wave Portal. The page gives no aid amounts, does not say whether admission is need-aware, and has no merit-scholarship information, so need-aware with limited aid is the closest category rather than a confirmed policy. Tulane offers 'limited need-based financial assistance' to international students; need-aware/need-blind status is not stated.
